name: Empty Platform (Persian RTL Blazor)
description: Reusable Persian RTL Blazor Server platform: Identity + OTP login, users and roles, permission-gated data-driven menu, audit log, notifications, outbox, API tokens, payments, Persian helpers and Excel/PDF import/export.
